title: The Refinery Surgeon's Incognito
logline: A disgraced core-world surgeon living under an assumed name as an ore refinery hygienist must risk exposing their identity to bounty hunters when a boiler explosion leaves dozens of laborers needing complex emergency surgery.

roles.description: Plant sanitation hygienist at an ore refinery; quiet, methodical, and hiding an elite medical pedigree.
Core-world extraction agent tracking high-value fugitives; polite, relentless, and calculating legal rewards.
Veteran refinery floor supervisor; protective of his crew and fiercely loyal to the quiet hygienist.
A sleek long-range pursuit craft fitted with high-gain civilian biometrics scanners.
A massive industrial refinery module choked with slag vapors and molten silicate pipes.
A cramped station dispensary stocked only with basic burn salves and generic painkillers.
The tight-knit collective of smelter workers who treat each other as family.

public_situation: An industrial boiler failure at {role:ore_smelting_slipway} leaves dozens of refinery crew severely burned, overwhelming local clinics.
private_truth: The plant hygienist is actually a renowned neurosurgeon who fled the core systems after taking the blame for a corrupt hospital trustee's fatal surgical blunder.

beats.public_change: Emergency sirens wail across the smelter bays as medical triage distress beacons blink outside {role:auxiliary_clinic_annex}.

missions.reason: She pays an outside pilot to collect an impounded kit of micro-surgical vascular clamps from a quarantined salvage depot before critically wounded workers succumb to shock.
missions.private_fact: The surgical kit is registered under her real name and will flag core warrant registries if logged into municipal station customs.

beats.public_change: {role:bounty_hunter_interceptor} docks at the station perimeter, downloading medical licensing queries into station port computers.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to deliver pure cuprite ore to the refinery power plant to restore emergency cooling coils before secondary boilers detonate.
missions.private_fact: He noticed the hygienist stitching complex arterial tears with master-class precision and realized she has been hiding her past for years.

beats.public_change: {role:bounty_hunter_captain} files an extraction bond with station marshals, posting armed pickets outside the clinic doors.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the bounty hunter's extradition warrant transmission to verify who funded the contract and whether it permits lethal force.
missions.private_fact: The warrant was funded by the core medical trustee whose career would be destroyed if she ever testified in open court.

beats.public_change: {role:bounty_hunter_interceptor} uncouples from the station dock, locking weapons onto the clinic module to enforce the prisoner extraction.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to disable the bounty interceptor's tractor arrays before it tears open the clinic hull to abduct the surgeon mid-operation.
missions.private_fact: The bounty hunter hails mid-battle offering half of the multi-million core extradition bounty if the pilot stands down and delivers the surgeon.

player_choice.prompt: With the bounty interceptor disabled and the surgery successfully concluded, the pilot must decide whether to shield the surgeon's new life, help her file counter-charges against the core trustee, or take the hunter's bounty payout.

options.label: Wipe customs records to let the surgeon remain as the refinery's beloved plant doctor under her assumed name
Transmit the trustee's illegal contract to municipal magistrates to clear her original medical record
Hand the surgeon over to the bounty hunter to collect the immense core extradition fee

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot wipes customs records and shields her identity.
resolutions.summary: The burned drillers recover. {role:refinery_shift_fraternity} protects {role:incognito_hygienist} with forged employee records, giving her a true home.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a disgraced core surgeon who saved thirty refinery workers during a boiler disaster.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot transmits the trustee's contract to magistrates.
resolutions.summary: The extortion warrant leaks to regional news boards. The corrupt core trustee is ousted, while {role:incognito_hygienist} regains her full medical license.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered evidence that cleared an exiled surgeon of fabricated medical malpractice charges.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the surgeon to the bounty hunter for the fee.
resolutions.summary: {role:bounty_hunter_captain} hauls the surgeon away in stasis. Unattended workers succumb to burn shock, leaving {role:refinery_shift_fraternity} decimated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold an incognito factory doctor to bounty hunters during a fatal boiler explosion.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the defense.
resolutions.summary: Smelter fires breach the auxiliary dispensary. The surgeon and wounded workers perish in the blaze, closing the refinery floor indefinitely.

loose_threads.detail: The titanium clamp case bears micro-engraved graduation honors from an elite core-world academy, partly ground away with steel wool.
An off-world private banking cartel posted a high-value recovery bounty whose escrow conditions require the target to remain permanently sedated.

radio_hooks: Industrial boiler rupture triggers mass casualty triage alarms at outer smelter docks.
Station marshals note influx of licensed bounty agents pursuing core fugitives.
Refinery union lodges formal protests over inadequate municipal medical provisions.

voice_direction.incognito_hygienist: Soft, clipped, and speaks with aristocratic precision that slips through her rough station vocabulary. Becomes completely calm under extreme medical pressure.
voice_direction.bounty_hunter_captain: Polite, methodical, and speaks in legalistic contractual clauses. Never raises his voice, even when issuing fatal ultimatums.
voice_direction.shift_foreman: Hoarse, protective, and speaks with fierce parental loyalty toward his crew. Curses loudly whenever station authorities are mentioned.
